title: Closing a tab that holds the scratch pane leaves the workspace naming a pane that is gone
body:
`State::remove_pane` in `compositor.rs` removes a pane from the layout, the router and `agents`, and clears `Workspace.scratch` when the pane was the scratch pane. `finish_closing_tab` removes every pane of a tab from the router and `agents` but does not touch `scratch`. After the tab closes, `Workspace::scratch_pane()` still names a pane no layout holds. I have not traced what `scratch.open` over MCP does then.

The fix belongs with the issue "Workspace owns adding, removing and pruning panes", which gives pane removal one home.
close_reason: Fixed in c577da4. Workspace::forget_pane clears the router entry, agent state and scratch mark, and both remove_tab and remove_pane call it. The test removing_the_tab_that_holds_the_scratch_pane_leaves_no_scratch_pane in workspace.rs failed before the fix.
